title: F4: pin the three safety properties of BEE_CHECK_ONLY
action: P1 FINDING (test-coverage reviewer): `rg BEE_CHECK_ONLY` across every suite hits only the implementation at scripts/lib/test-fixture.mjs:96-190 — the filter shipped with zero tests. Its three safety properties were verified by hand and pinned by nothing, so a regression that counts skips as passes, or that lets a zero-match filter exit 0, would silently turn all 31 shared-fixture suites trivially green. FIX: add a suite (new file under scripts/tests/, e.g. test_check_filter.mjs — new_suite_reason: the filter is a harness-level mechanism with no owning suite) that pins, using a throwaway fixture suite it writes into a temp dir and runs as a child process: (1) with BEE_CHECK_ONLY unset the output and exit code are byte-identical to the pre-filter behaviour — no skip counter, no extra text; (2) with a substring value only matching checks execute, non-matching are counted as skipped and the summary names the filter; (3) a value wrapped in slashes is honoured as a regex, including flags; (4) a filter matching zero checks exits NON-ZERO with the typed refusal, never a trivial green; (5) an INVALID regex (e.g. `/[/`) does not crash every suite at module load — assert the current behaviour and, if it throws, make it a typed refusal instead (that is a real P3 the code-quality reviewer also raised; fixing it here is in scope). Do not modify the filter's semantics beyond point (5). You MAY run your new suite and must quote it; run nothing else. GIT SAFETY (shared checkout): commit through your own temp index (GIT_INDEX_FILE + read-tree/update-index/write-tree/commit-tree/update-ref); NEVER plain git add, NEVER reset/stash/checkout/restore.
